title: One experiment's analysis result, as the product imports it
description: Written by `analyse-experiments` to experiments/results/r={run}/{key}.json (services/recs/README.md, "Experiment results"). The importer calls `saveExperimentResults(key, report, Date.parse(computedAt))`; the staff route `GET /api/admin/v1/experiments/:key/results` answers `{key, computedAt, report}`. `report` is that experiment's element of the run's report: schemas/experiment-report.schema.json, `$defs.experiment`.

computedAt.description: When the analysis ran (the run's generatedAt): the product's computedAt.

asOf.description: Knowledge cutoff: only events received before it were read.
